entities.summary: Takuya Asanuma (b. 1971-09-09, Kyoto Prefecture) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kyoto Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
